 Sub : Bill call memo for Outstanding Advance(s).
The following advance(s) is/are outstanding in the books of this office. You are requested to submit the adjustment
claim(s) at an early date.
As per Rule 17-A 2 of TR, the claim for moves of transfer, tour and LTC when TA advance  is drawn for the journey
are to be preffered within the following time limits :
 a) Transfer  :  One year from the date of completion of journey.
 b) Tour        :  Within 15 days of issue of DO order Part II promulgating regularization of the move.
 c) LTC         :  Within one month of the completion of journey.
Officers are advised to adhere to the time limit prescribrd in the above provisions for submission of their adjustment
claims, failing which the amount will be recovered in the ensuing statement of account.
